The nature conservation station in the Lower Lusatian Heath Nature Park offers various tours to particularly beautiful spots and on specific topics on set dates every year. For groups of ten people or more, these tours can be arranged on a convenient date. Anyone who goes on a Ranger Tour will have some stories to tell: from the joyous singing of birds in spring and the cries of birds and amphibians to unforgettable experiences with cranes and perhaps also encounters with kingfishers, sea eagles, nightjars and others.
